purpose: Small deterministic cases for checking BLUEVERSE skill/rule routing without loading the repository.

cases.task: Optimize a React 19 Vite component that fetches public API data.
Add a typed Flutter model for a public API response.
Plan a BLUEVERSE workflow for clients, staff and administrators across React Web and Flutter Mobile with a realistic user-facing experience.
mustExclude: assigning client-facing work to Flutter only

cases.task: Implement an ASP.NET Core endpoint with validation and OpenAPI metadata.
mustExclude: sample service generation when the project is absent

cases.task: Add, update or remove an ASP.NET API controller route and synchronize the endpoint catalog JSON and generated Markdown before completion.
Review whether existing tests would catch a caller-visible production mutation.
Review or design an Agentic AI approval and tool-validation workflow; follow the v1 G07 gate before executable implementation.
mustExclude: implementing the v1 runtime before G07

cases.task: Implement a v1 member component after G00, including its private service, public API integration, both clients and the pre-G07 Agentic AI access seam.
mustExclude: direct client access to a private service

cases.task: After all four v1 member components pass G07, implement an Agentic AI specialist on its assigned agentic-ai branch.
mustExclude: implementing runtime code on a features branch
direct React or Flutter access to the agent service
treating external ML integration as an agent

cases.task: Audit repository readiness and report missing foundation components.
Add an EF Core migration for a PostgreSQL-backed Auth model and review the upgrade path.
Investigate a slow EF Core query and verify its PostgreSQL translation and indexes.
Add a PostgreSQL integration test for a transaction, constraint, migration or concurrency behavior.
mustExclude: using only InMemory for provider behavior

cases.task: Quickly determine the implemented PostgreSQL schema, migrations and test-provider boundaries.
mustExclude: treating future Agentic AI tables as implemented
